rules.principle: A physical lane is not established by geographic proximity.
rules.implication: Never assert ships_to from distance alone.

rules.principle: Carrier coverage and service compatibility are separate from physical accessibility.
rules.implication: Treat carrier and mode as unknown absent evidence.

rules.principle: Transit time and freight cost depend on mode, route, capacity and service.
rules.implication: Do not infer contractual rates from road distance.

rules.principle: Inventory can be positioned at different echelons with distinct availability and ownership.
rules.implication: Do not assume inventory is freely transferable.

rules.principle: Stock availability depends on product, facility, time and allocation.
rules.implication: A facility capability does not prove on-hand quantity.

rules.principle: Replenishment policies can differ by item, facility and channel.
rules.implication: Do not assume a uniform reorder rule.

rules.principle: A facility may serve multiple channels with distinct eligibility rules.
rules.implication: Store fulfillment capability does not prove every SKU can ship.

rules.principle: A market may be served by multiple facilities.
rules.implication: Avoid forcing single-source relationships.

rules.principle: Production capability is product- and resource-specific.
rules.implication: Do not assume every plant makes every product.

rules.principle: Capacity can be constrained by labor, equipment, material and time.
rules.implication: Do not infer production capacity from building area alone.

rules.principle: Approved suppliers and contracts may restrict otherwise feasible sourcing.
rules.implication: Do not treat possible supplier as approved.

rules.principle: Lead times vary by supplier, product and order conditions.
rules.implication: Do not fabricate supplier lead times.

rules.principle: Facility labels are imperfect proxies for operating capabilities.
rules.implication: Prefer disclosed capabilities over name-based assumptions.

rules.principle: A cross-dock may transfer goods without stocking inventory.
rules.implication: Do not assume inventory storage at cross-docks.

rules.principle: Temperature-sensitive goods require compatible handling across the path.
rules.implication: Do not assume compatibility without evidence.

rules.principle: An organization can use multiple network patterns simultaneously.
rules.implication: Compose patterns rather than assign one exclusive archetype.

rules.principle: Ownership, operation and physical flow are different relationships.
rules.implication: Represent separately.

rules.principle: A source can describe a general operating model without naming exact endpoints.
rules.implication: Store general policy separately from specific edges.

rules.principle: Public statements can become stale after network changes.
rules.implication: Record publication and retrieval dates.

rules.principle: An absence of public evidence is not proof that a relationship does not exist.
rules.implication: Represent unknown, not false.

rules.principle: Industry patterns generate hypotheses, not verified company facts.
rules.implication: Mark hypothetical edges explicitly.

rules.principle: Different sources can disagree about facility roles or counts.
rules.implication: Preserve conflicting claims for review.

rules.principle: Population and sales geography can proxy demand but do not establish actual orders.
rules.implication: Label estimates and document method.

rules.principle: Demand granularity varies by product, channel, market and time.
rules.implication: Do not invent SKU-level demand from aggregate revenue.
